description.description: Human-readable description. Possible values: <= 65535 characters, must match ^[\s\S]*$

dpxlFilter.description: The dpxl filter. Possible values: <= 65535 characters, must match ^[\s\S]*$

name.description: Display name. Non-empty and <= 50 characters, must match ^[\s\S]*$

sourceType.description: Source type. Possible values: SOURCE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, SOURCE_TYPE_LOG, SOURCE_TYPE_DATA_MAP

url.description: URL. Must start with http:// or https://. Non-empty and <= 32768 characters, must match ^https?://.*$

urlFields.description: The url fields. Each field requires both name and required, and names must be unique within the list. Possible values: <= 1000
